design.provider_strategy: separate provider boundaries for operational and reserve authenticators where practical
design.authorization: signature-agnostic quorum separated from member signature algorithm
design.authority_identity: stable account or vault identifier with replaceable validator/authenticator
design.recovery: precommitted independent recovery path plus controlled recovery drills
execution_ladder: notional dry-run with zero live asset exposure
independently reviewed bounded-value canary with explicit human authorization

evidence.name: Google Cloud KMS quantum-safe digital signatures
evidence.statement: Google Cloud announced general availability of ML-DSA and SLH-DSA signatures and ML-KEM in Cloud KMS in July 2026.

evidence.name: Entrust nShield as a Service
evidence.statement: Entrust documents FIPS 140-3 nShield service support for ML-DSA and SLH-DSA through standard cryptographic interfaces.

evidence.name: NIST post-quantum standards and crypto agility
evidence.statement: ML-DSA and SLH-DSA are standardized post-quantum signature families and NIST recommends migration now with crypto-agile architecture.

evidence.name: Signature-agnostic threshold authorization
evidence.statement: A 2026 design separates member authentication from distributed threshold authorization so signature-family migration can be treated as key rotation rather than custody-protocol redesign.

evidence.name: Project Eleven quantum-vault account abstraction
evidence.statement: The audited ERC-4337 reference architecture keeps account identity stable while allowing the validator responsible for signature checking to be replaced; its released validator support is still classical.

evidence.name: Sui algorithm-diversity design
evidence.statement: Sui is implementing ML-DSA-65 for native accounts and SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s for high-value Move vaults, explicitly using separate mathematical families for resilience.

required_before_testnet_claim: exercise both signing providers with reproducible vectors
validate chain adapter end-to-end on a non-production network
prove fail-closed behavior when a classical bypass is attempted
verify immutable evidence capture through the Worldshepherd audit path
precommit and test the recovery authority
required_before_any_live_value_canary: independent review of the complete integrated path
explicit human authorization and change-control record
claims_boundary: This pilot does not make an underlying blockchain quantum-safe.
Commercial availability of PQ signing does not prove Worldshepherd integration until exercised.
No live-value transaction is authorized by this evidence record.
Base-layer consensus, bridge authorities, stablecoin administration, and validator authentication remain separate migration domains.
